bias.zh: 反弹受阻 · $191.7 遇阻回落，守住 $181

read.en: Arm slipped 0.3% on Nov 18 to $182.76, fading from a $191.65 high to a $181.00 low. It is below the 5-day ($186.3, rising), 10-day ($184.4, falling), 30-day ($213.8), 100-day ($257.0) and 200-day ($233.9). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 12, below zero, histogram widening slightly; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($198.37), and RSI is 39.8.
read.zh: Arm 11月18日下跌 0.3%，收于 $182.76，自高点 $191.65 回落至低点 $181.00。股价位于 5 日（$186.3，上行）、10 日（$184.4，下行）、30 日（$213.8）、100 日（$257.0）和 200 日均线（$233.9）下方。MACD 自 11月12日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图小幅放大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$198.37），RSI 为 39.8。

read.en: The $191.65 high pushed through the 10 and 5-day intraday, but the close fell back below both; the $181.00 low held the $180.5–181.5 support. Resistance is $184.4–186.3 (10 and 5-day, Nov 9 close), then $188.4–191.7 (Nov 11 low, Nov 18 high) and $196–199.4 (SAR). Support is $180.5–181.5, then $173.2–175 and $163–167. A close above $186.3 would target $191.7; below $180.5, $173–175.
